ip_address.description: Client IP address to use for SPF check.

sender_address.description: Envelope sender (Mail From) address from which mail was received.

helo_hostname.description: HELO/EHLO name used by the SMTP client.

rcpt_to_address.description: Receipt to address, useful for logging and constructing rejection messages.

local_policy.description: Additional SPF mechanisms to be checked on the basis of local policy.

default_explanation.description: Default explanation string to be used if the query fails.
